assumptions: Tokens = duplicate characters x 0.3384 (claims ledger recon.t0rag.coef_rag, OLS over turn-0 single-call billed RAG requests): a hypothetical reconstruction, not a tokenizer count.
Saved tokens come out of uncached input only (chunks follow the target message, A-84, outside the cacheable prefix), capped at the row's uncached input.
A multi-call request saves once, not once per call.

Repriced: logged tokens less saved tokens at the price table's tiers; a lower input can move a request to a cheaper tier. Fees are not priced in price-file units (ADR-0036), so baseline_cost has no fees key.
Fees unchanged: a context version never changes fees.
Whether Metis actually sent the duplicate copies is unknown (U-04); the quality of dropping a copy is unmeasured (FR-CTX-03).
Report split only (replay_scope.split_by_session); workflow rows are in no numerator.
